attempts.text: {"claims":[{"claim_text":"Democrats believe in an immigration system that balances strong enforcement of laws with fair and evenhanded treatment of immigrants and their families.", "claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The Clinton-Gore administration provided leadership in dramatically improving border management and law enforcement.", "claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The Clinton-Gore administration expanded the Border Patrol.", "claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The Clinton-Gore administration placed curbs on abuses of the asylum process.", "claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The current immigration system fails to effectively control illegal immigration.", "claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The current immigration system has serious adverse impacts on state and local services.", "claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The current immigration system has serious adverse impacts on many communities and workers.", "claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The current immigration system has led to an alarming number of deaths of migrants on the border.", "claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democrats are committed to reexamining and fixing failed immigration policies.", "claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
